scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:protocol && npm run build --workspace @roan/server && npm run build --workspace @roan/client
scripts.test:online: npm run build:core && npm run build:protocol && npm run build --workspace @roan/server && npm run smoke --workspace @roan/server
scripts.test:online:soak: npm run build:core && npm run build:protocol && npm run build --workspace @roan/server && node apps/server/dist/team-soak.js
scripts.format: prettier --write packages apps package.json tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check packages apps package.json tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:browser: npm run build:core && playwright test --config apps/client/playwright.config.mjs
scripts.test:browser:online: npm run build:protocol && playwright test --config apps/client/online.playwright.config.mjs
